sentences.zh: 廣順元年冬十月己丑朔，宰臣王峻獻唐張蘊古《大寶箴》、謝偃《惟皇誡德賦》二圖。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, winter, in the first year of Guangshun, chief minister Wang Jun presented two illustrated scrolls: Tang Zhang Yungu's "Great Treasure Admonition" and Xie Yan's "Exhortation on Imperial Virtue."
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month, winter, Guangshun year 1, Chief Minister Wang Jun presented two illustrated works from the Tang: Zhang Yungu's Great Treasure Admonition and Xie Yan's Exhortation on Imperial Virtue.

sentences.zh: 詔報曰：「朕生長軍戎，勤勞南北，雖用心於《鈐》、《匱》，且無暇於《詩》、《書》，世務時艱，粗經閱歷，前言往行，未甚討尋。

translations.literal: An edict in reply said: "I was raised in the army camps and have toiled north and south. Though I have applied myself to the Seals and Chests, I have had no leisure for the Odes and Documents. The affairs of the age and its hardships I have only roughly experienced; the words and deeds of past ages I have not greatly pursued."
translations.idiomatic: An edict in reply said: "I grew up in the camps and have labored north and south. Though I have bent my mind to military registers and ordnance chests, I have had no leisure for the Odes and Documents. The troubles of the age I have only roughly lived through, and the words and deeds of former times I have not deeply studied."

sentences.zh: 卿有佐命立國之勛，居代天調鼎之任，恒慮眇德，未及古人。

translations.literal: You have merit in aiding the Mandate and founding the state, and hold the office of regulating the tripod on Heaven's behalf; you have constantly worried over my slight virtue, which falls short of the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: You have the merit of aiding the Mandate and establishing the state, and you hold the charge of tuning the national tripod on Heaven's behalf; you have always worried that my slight virtue does not measure up to the ancients.

sentences.zh: 於是采掇箴規，弼諧寡昧，披文閱理，懌意怡神，究為君治國之源，審修己御人之要。

translations.literal: Therefore you gathered admonitions and maxims to aid my dim understanding. Unfolding the text and examining its principles delights the mind and refreshes the spirit; it probes the source of governing the state as ruler and clearly sets forth the essentials of cultivating oneself and controlling others.
translations.idiomatic: You therefore gathered admonitions and maxims to assist my dull understanding. Reading the text and weighing its principles delights the mind and calms the spirit; it investigates the source of ruling and governing the state, and clearly discerns the essentials of cultivating oneself and directing others.

sentences.zh: 帝王之道，盡在於茲，辭翰俱高，珠寶何貴！

translations.literal: The way of emperors and kings is all here. The prose and brushwork are both lofty — what treasure could be more precious!
translations.idiomatic: The way of emperors and kings is wholly contained in these works; the prose and calligraphy are both superb — what jewel could be more precious!

sentences.zh: 再三省覽，深用愧嘉。

translations.literal: Having read them again and again, I am deeply abashed yet greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: I have read them again and again and am deeply ashamed of my shortcomings, yet greatly pleased by your gift.

sentences.zh: 其所進圖，已令於行坐處張懸，所冀出入看讀，用為鑒戒。

translations.literal: As for the scrolls you presented, I have ordered them hung where I pass in and out of court, hoping that going and coming I may read them and take them as a mirror and warning.
translations.idiomatic: The scrolls you presented have been ordered hung wherever I walk or sit, so that as I come and go I may read them and take them as a mirror and warning.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，潞州奏，巡檢使陳思讓、監軍向訓破河東賊軍於虒亭。

translations.literal: " On renchen, Lu Prefecture reported that patrol commissioner Chen Siyang and military supervisor Xiang Xun defeated the Hedong rebel army at Si Ting.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen, Lu Prefecture reported that Patrol Commissioner Chen Siyang and Military Supervisor Xiang Xun had defeated the Hedong rebel army at Si Ting.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以刑部侍郎司徒詡為戶部侍郎，以左散騎常侍張煦為刑部侍郎，以給事中呂咸休為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On guisi, Vice Minister of Punishment Situ Xu was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue; Left Regular Attendant Zhang Xu was appointed Vice Minister of Punishment; Secretariat Drafter Lü Xianxiu was appointed Left Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Situ Xu, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Punishment, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Zhang Xu, Left Regular Attendant, was made Vice Minister of Punishment; and Lü Xianxiu, Secretariat Drafter, was made Left Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 甲午，絳州防禦使孫漢英卒。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Jiang Prefecture defense commissioner Sun Hanying died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Sun Hanying, Defense Commissioner of Jiang Prefecture, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，荊南奏，湖南亂，大將軍陸孟俊執偽節度使馬希萼遷於衡州，立希萼弟希崇為留後，將吏二千餘人，遇害者半，牙署庫藏焚燒殆盡。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Jingnan reported that Hunan was in turmoil: Grand General Lu Mengjun seized the false military commissioner Ma Xie and moved him to Heng Prefecture, installed Xie's younger brother Xichong as acting commissioner, and among more than two thousand officers and clerks half were killed; the military headquarters stores were nearly all burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jingnan reported that Hunan was in disorder: Grand General Lu Mengjun seized the puppet Military Commissioner Ma Xie, relocated him to Heng Prefecture, and installed Xie's younger brother Xichong as acting commissioner. Of more than two thousand officers and clerks, half were killed, and the headquarters stores were burned almost to nothing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔並吏部三銓為一銓，委本司長官通判。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered the three selection boards of the Ministry of Personnel merged into one, with the head of the ministry to oversee it jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict merged the Ministry of Personnel's three selection boards into one and entrusted joint oversight to the ministry's chief official.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晉州巡檢王萬敢奏，河東劉崇入寇，營於州北。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Jin Prefecture patrol officer Wang Wangan reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had invaded and encamped north of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jin Prefecture Patrol Officer Wang Wangan reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had invaded and was encamped north of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，潞州奏，河東賊軍寇境。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Lu Prefecture reported that Hedong rebel troops were raiding the border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Lu Prefecture reported that Hedong rebel forces were raiding the border.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，荊南奏，淮南遣鄂州節度使劉仁贍，以戰船二百艘於今月二十五日入岳州。

translations.literal: On yimao, Jingnan reported that Huainan had sent E Prefecture military commissioner Liu Renzan with two hundred warships, which entered Yue Prefecture on the twenty-fifth of this month.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jingnan reported that Huainan had dispatched E Prefecture Military Commissioner Liu Renzan with two hundred warships, which entered Yue Prefecture on the twenty-fifth of this month.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔樞密使王峻率兵援晉州。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict ordered Privy Council commissioner Wang Jun to lead troops to relieve Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to lead troops to relieve Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左衛將軍申師厚為河西軍節度使、檢校太保。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Left Guard General Shen Shihou was appointed military commissioner of Hexi Army and Acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Shen Shihou, General of the Left Guard, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Hexi Army and Acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 師厚素與王峻善，及峻貴，師厚羈旅無依，日於峻馬前望塵而拜，會西涼請帥，帝令擇之，無欲去者，峻乃以師厚奏之，師厚亦欣然求往，尋自前鎮將授左衛將軍、檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Shihou had long been on good terms with Wang Jun. When Jun rose to high rank, Shihou, a wanderer without support, daily bowed in the dust before Jun's horse. When Western Liang requested a commander, the emperor ordered one chosen; no one wished to go. Jun then recommended Shihou, and Shihou also gladly sought the post. Shortly before, from former frontier commander he had been appointed Left Guard General and Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shihou had long been friendly with Wang Jun. When Jun rose to power, Shihou, adrift without patronage, daily bowed in the dust before Jun's horse. When Western Liang requested a commander, the emperor ordered someone chosen, but no one wished to go. Jun then recommended Shihou, who gladly sought the post. Shortly before, he had been promoted from a former frontier commander to Left Guard General and Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 翌日，乃有涼州之命，賜旌節、駝馬、繒帛以遣之。

translations.literal: The next day came the appointment to Liang Prefecture, and he was sent off with banners of authority, camels, horses, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the appointment to Liang Prefecture was issued, and he was sent off with banners of authority, camels, horses, and silks.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，荊南奏，淮南大將邊鎬率兵三萬，自袁州路趨潭州，馬希崇遣從事送牌印，納器仗。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, jiawei, Jingnan reported that Huainan's great general Bian Hao led thirty thousand troops from the Yuan Prefecture route toward Tan Prefecture; Ma Xichong sent an aide to deliver seals and insignia and surrender weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, jiawei, Jingnan reported that Huainan's Grand General Bian Hao was leading thirty thousand men from the Yuan Prefecture route toward Tan Prefecture, and that Ma Xichong had sent an aide to deliver his seals and insignia and surrender his arms.

sentences.zh: 鎬入城，稱武安軍節度使，馬氏諸族及將吏千餘人皆徙於金陵。

translations.literal: Hao entered the city and styled himself military commissioner of Wu'an Army; more than a thousand of the Ma clan and their officers were relocated to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Hao entered the city and took the title Military Commissioner of the Wu'an Army; more than a thousand members of the Ma clan and their officers were relocated to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，東南白虹亙天。

translations.literal: On the night of jiazi, a white rainbow stretched across the sky in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiazi, a white rainbow spanned the sky in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 以新晉州節度使王彥超為晉絳行營馬軍都虞候。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Jin Prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanchao was made chief adjutant of cavalry for the Jin-Jiang campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao, the newly appointed Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made Chief Adjutant of Cavalry for the Jin-Jiang campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命王峻出征晉州，帝幸西莊以餞之。

translations.literal: On yichou, Wang Jun was ordered to campaign to Jin Prefecture; the emperor visited the Western Villa to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Wang Jun was ordered to march on Jin Prefecture, and the emperor went to the Western Villa to give him a farewell feast.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，日南至，群臣拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the winter solstice; the ministers presented memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the winter solstice arrived, and the ministers presented congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬故貴妃張氏。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the late Honored Consort Zhang was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the late Honored Consort Zhang was buried.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔：「唐朝五廟，舊在至德宮安置，應屬徽陵莊田園舍，宜令新除右監門將軍李重玉為主。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict said: "The five temples of the Tang dynasty, formerly housed at Zhide Palace, together with the estates and gardens belonging to Huiling should be placed under the newly appointed Right Gate General Li Chongyu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict said: "The Tang dynasty's five ancestral temples, formerly kept at Zhide Palace, together with the estates and gardens belonging to Huiling, should be entrusted to the newly appointed Right Gate General Li Chongyu.

sentences.zh: 其緣陵緣廟法物，除合留外，所有金銀器物，充遷葬故淑妃王氏及許王從益外，其餘並給與重玉及尼惠英、惠燈、惠能、惠嚴等。

translations.literal: Among ritual objects for the tomb and temples, apart from what should be retained, all gold and silver vessels, except those used for reburial of the late Shufei Wang and Prince Xu Congyi, were to be given to Chongyu and the nuns Huiying, Huideng, Huineng, Huiyan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Of the ritual objects for the tomb and temples, aside from what must be kept, all gold and silver vessels—except those needed to reinter the late Shufei Wang and Prince Xu Congyi—were to be given to Chongyu and the nuns Huiying, Huideng, Huineng, Huiyan, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 令重玉以時祀陵廟，務在豐潔。

translations.literal: Chongyu was ordered to sacrifice at the tomb and temples on schedule, with the offerings to be full and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyu was ordered to perform timely sacrifices at the tomb and temples, with offerings to be ample and splendid.

sentences.zh: 」重玉，故皇城使李從璨之子，明宗之孫，惠英等亦明宗親屬也，故帝授重玉官秩，令主先祀，恤王者之後也。

translations.literal: " Chongyu was son of the former Imperial City Commissioner Li Congcan and grandson of Emperor Mingzong; Huiying and the others were also Mingzong's kin. Therefore the emperor granted Chongyu office and rank, put him in charge of the former sacrifices, and showed compassion for the descendants of kings.
translations.idiomatic: " Chongyu was the son of the former Imperial City Commissioner Li Congcan and a grandson of Emperor Mingzong; Huiying and the others were also Mingzong's kin. The emperor therefore granted Chongyu office and rank, put him in charge of the former sacrifices, and showed compassion for a king's descendants.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子朔，詔以劉崇入寇，取當月三日暫幸西京。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, wuzi, an edict, because Liu Chong had invaded, set the third day of that month for a temporary visit to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, wuzi, an edict—because Liu Chong had invaded—set the third day of that month for a temporary visit to the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔巡幸宜停。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict ordered the tour to be halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict ordered the tour suspended.

sentences.zh: 時王峻駐軍陜府，聞帝西巡，遣使馳奏，不勞車駕順動，帝乃止。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Jun was encamped at Shan Prefecture. Hearing that the emperor was touring west, he sent a messenger in haste to report that there was no need for the imperial carriage to move; the emperor then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun was then encamped at Shan Prefecture. When he heard the emperor was touring west, he sent a fast messenger urging that the imperial carriage need not move; the emperor then halted the plan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the emperor visited the Western Villa.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the emperor visited the Western Villa.

sentences.zh: 兗州慕容彥超上言，乞朝覲，詔允之，尋稱部內草寇起，不敢離鎮。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture's Murong Yanchao memorialized requesting an audience; the edict granted it, but soon he claimed bandits had risen within his command and dared not leave his post.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao of Yan Prefecture memorialized asking to come to court; the edict assented, but soon he claimed bandits had risen in his territory and dared not leave his post.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鄆州奏，慕容彥超據城反。

translations.literal: On wushen, Yun Prefecture reported that Murong Yanchao had seized the city and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yun Prefecture reported that Murong Yanchao had seized the city and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王峻奏，劉崇逃遁，王師已入晉州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Wang Jun reported that Liu Chong had fled and the imperial army had entered Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Jun reported that Liu Chong had fled and that imperial forces had already taken Jin Prefecture.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陳思讓傳》：王峻援晉州，以思讓與康延昭分為左右廂排陣使，令率軍自烏嶺路至絳州，與大軍合。

translations.literal: (From the Song History, Biography of Chen Siyang: When Wang Jun relieved Jin Prefecture, he made Siyang and Kang Yanzhao left and right wing array marshals, ordering them to lead troops from Wuling Road to Jiang Prefecture to join the main army.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Song History, Biography of Chen Siyang: When Wang Jun relieved Jin Prefecture, he made Siyang and Kang Yanzhao marshals of the left and right wings, ordering them to lead troops from Wuling Road to Jiang Prefecture to join the main army.

sentences.zh: 崇燒營遁去，思讓又與藥元福襲破之。）〉

translations.literal: Chong burned his camp and fled; Siyang again joined Yao Yuanfu in a surprise attack and defeated him.)
translations.idiomatic: Chong burned his camp and fled; Siyang again joined Yao Yuanfu in a surprise attack and routed him.)

sentences.zh: 廣順二年春正月戊午朔，不受朝賀，以宿兵在外故也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month, spring, in the second year of Guangshun, wuwu, court congratulations were not received, because troops were still abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month, spring, Guangshun year 2, wuwu, the court did not receive congratulatory audiences, because troops were still in the field.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王峻奏，起近鎮丁夫二萬城晉州。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Jun reported that twenty thousand corvée laborers from nearby prefectures were levied to fortify Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Jun reported that twenty thousand corvée laborers from nearby prefectures had been levied to fortify Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，修東京羅城，凡役丁夫五萬五千，兩旬而罷。

translations.literal: On renxu, the outer wall of the Eastern Capital was repaired; fifty-five thousand corvée laborers were employed, and the work was finished in twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the outer wall of the Eastern Capital was repaired; fifty-five thousand corvée laborers were employed, and the work was completed in twenty days.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英為兗州行營都部署，以齊州防禦使史延韜為副部署，以皇城使向訓為兵馬都監，陳州防禦使藥元福為馬步都虞候，率兵討慕容彥超。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Imperial Guard infantry commander Cao Ying was made overall commander of the Yan campaign headquarters; Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Shi Yantao was made deputy commander; Imperial City commissioner Xiang Xun was made overall military supervisor; Chen Prefecture defense commissioner Yao Yuanfu was made chief adjutant of horse and foot, leading troops to attack Murong Yanchao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Cao Ying, Commander of the Imperial Guard Infantry, was made Overall Commander of the Yan campaign headquarters; Shi Yantao, Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made Deputy Commander; Xiang Xun, Imperial City Commissioner, was made Overall Military Supervisor; Yao Yuanfu, Defense Commissioner of Chen Prefecture, was made Chief Adjutant of Horse and Foot, and led troops against Murong Yanchao.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《隆平集》：慕容彥超盜據兗、海，周祖命曹英為帥，向訓副之，參用藥元福以兵從。

translations.literal: (From the Longping Collection: Murong Yanchao seized Yan and Hai by force. The Zhou founder appointed Cao Ying commander and Xiang Xun as his deputy, with Yao Yuanfu joining the army.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Longping Collection: Murong Yanchao seized Yan and Hai by force. The Zhou founder appointed Cao Ying commander and Xiang Xun his deputy, with Yao Yuanfu joining the army.

sentences.zh: 謂元福曰：「已敕英、訓，勿以軍禮見汝。

translations.literal: He said to Yuanfu: "I have already ordered Ying and Xun not to receive you with full military ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: He told Yuanfu: "I have already ordered Ying and Xun not to receive you with full military ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」及元福至，英、訓皆父事焉。）〉

translations.literal: " When Yuanfu arrived, both Ying and Xun treated him as a father.)
translations.idiomatic: " When Yuanfu arrived, both Ying and Xun treated him with the deference due a father.)

sentences.zh: 諸軍入兗州界，不得下路停止村舍，犯者以軍法從事。

translations.literal: When the armies entered Yan Prefecture's territory, they were not permitted to leave the road and stop in villages; violators were dealt with by military law.
translations.idiomatic: When the armies entered Yan territory, they were forbidden to leave the road and halt in villages; violators were punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，徐州巡檢供給官張令彬奏，破淮賊於沭陽，斬首千餘級，擒賊將燕敬權。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Xuzhou patrol supply officer Zhang Lingbin reported defeating Huai rebels at Shuyang, beheading more than a thousand and capturing the rebel general Yan Jingquan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xuzhou Patrol Supply Officer Zhang Lingbin reported defeating Huai rebels at Shuyang, beheading more than a thousand and capturing the rebel general Yan Jingquan.

sentences.zh: 時慕容彥超求援於淮南，淮南偽主李景發兵援之，師於下邳，聞官軍至，退趨沭陽，遂破之。

translations.literal: At the time Murong Yanchao sought aid from Huainan; the false ruler of Huainan, Li Jing, sent troops to aid him. The army was at Xiapi; hearing the imperial army had arrived, they retreated toward Shuyang and were there defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao was then seeking aid from Huainan; Huainan's puppet ruler Li Jing sent troops to help him. The army was at Xiapi; when it heard the imperial army had arrived, it retreated toward Shuyang and was defeated there.

sentences.zh: 庚午，高麗權知國事王昭遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Wang Zhao, acting ruler of Goryeo, sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Zhao, Acting Ruler of Goryeo, sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鎮州何福進差人部送先擒獲到河東賊軍二百餘人至闕下，詔給巾履衫袴以釋之。

translations.literal: On renshen, He Fujin of Zhen Prefecture sent men escorting more than two hundred Hedong rebel troops previously captured to the capital; an edict gave them caps, shoes, shirts, and trousers and released them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, He Fujin of Zhen Prefecture sent men escorting more than two hundred previously captured Hedong rebel troops to the capital; an edict gave them caps, shoes, shirts, and trousers and released them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，徐州部送沭陽所獲賊將燕敬權等四人至闕下，詔賜衣服金帛，放歸本土，敬權等感泣謝罪。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Xuzhou sent the four captives taken at Shuyang, including rebel general Yan Jingquan, to the capital; an edict granted them clothing and gold silks and sent them home. Jingquan and the others wept and thanked for their pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xuzhou delivered to the capital four captives taken at Shuyang, among them the rebel general Yan Jingquan. An edict awarded them clothing and silk and sent them home; Jingquan and the others wept in gratitude and begged forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 帝召見謂之曰：「夫惡兇邪，獎忠順，天下一也。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned them and said: "To hate the vicious and evil and reward the loyal and upright is one principle throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned them and said: "To hate the vicious and reward the loyal is one principle throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 我之賊臣，撓亂國法，嬰城作逆，殃及生靈，不意吳人助茲兇惡，非良算也，爾當歸言之於爾君。

translations.literal: My rebel subject has disturbed the laws of the state, held the city in revolt, and harmed the people. I did not expect the Wu people to aid such wickedness — it is no good plan. You should return and tell your lord.
translations.idiomatic: My rebel subject has disturbed the laws of the state, held his city in revolt, and harmed the people. I did not expect the Wu people to aid such wickedness — it is no sound policy. You should return and tell your lord.

sentences.zh: 」初，漢末遣三司軍將路昌祚於湖南市茶，屬淮南將邊鎬陷長沙，昌祚被賊送金陵。

translations.literal: " Earlier, at the end of Han, the Three Departments had sent army officer Lu Changzuo to Hunan to buy tea. When Huainan general Bian Hao took Changsha, Changzuo was seized by the rebels and sent to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, toward the end of Han, the Three Departments had dispatched the army officer Lu Changzuo to Hunan to purchase tea. When the Huainan general Bian Hao captured Changsha, Changzuo was taken by the rebels and sent to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 及敬權自大朝歸，具以帝言告於李景，景乃召昌祚，延坐從容久之，且稱美大朝皇帝聖德廣被，恩沾鄰土，深有依附國家之意。

translations.literal: When Jingquan returned from the Great Court, he fully reported the emperor's words to Li Jing. Jing then summoned Changzuo, seated him at leisure for a long while, and praised the Great Court emperor's sagely virtue spreading widely and his grace reaching neighboring lands, showing deep intent to attach to the state.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingquan returned from the Great Court, he fully reported the emperor's words to Li Jing. Jing then summoned Changzuo and entertained him at leisure for a long while, praising the Great Court emperor's sagely virtue and his grace reaching neighboring lands, and showing deep intent to attach to the state.

sentences.zh: 及罷，遣偽宰相宋齊丘宴昌祚於別館，又令訪昌祚在湖南遭變之時，亡失綱運之數，命依數償之，給茗荈萬八千斤，遣水運至江夏，仍厚給行裝，遣之歸闕。

translations.literal: When the audience ended, he sent the false chancellor Song Qiqiu to feast Changzuo at a separate lodge, and also had him inquire how much tea revenue Changzuo had lost when disaster struck in Hunan, ordering compensation according to the figure; he gave eighteen thousand jin of tea, sent it by water transport to Jiangxia, still gave generous travel supplies, and sent him back to court.
translations.idiomatic: When the audience ended, he sent the puppet chancellor Song Qiqiu to feast Changzuo at a separate lodge, and also had him inquire how much tea revenue Changzuo had lost when disaster struck in Hunan, ordering compensation in full; he gave eighteen thousand jin of tea, sent it by water to Jiangxia, gave generous travel supplies, and sent him back to court.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，府州防卸使折德扆奏，河東賊軍寇境，率州兵破之，斬首二千級。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, Fu Prefecture defense commissioner Zhe Dewei reported that Hedong rebel troops raided the border; he led prefectural troops and defeated them, beheading two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, Zhe Dewei, Defense Commissioner of Fu Prefecture, reported that Hedong rebel troops raided the border; he led prefectural troops, defeated them, and beheaded two thousand.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Great White Star crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以權知高麗國事王昭為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On guisi, Wang Zhao, acting ruler of Goryeo, was made King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wang Zhao, Acting Ruler of Goryeo, was made King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，府州防卸使折德扆奏，收河東界岢嵐軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Fu Prefecture defense commissioner Zhe Dewei reported recovering Kelan Army on the Hedong border.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhe Dewei, Defense Commissioner of Fu Prefecture, reported recovering Kelan Army on the Hedong border.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔先獲河東鄉軍一百餘人，各給錢鞋放歸鄉里。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict ordered that more than a hundred Hedong militiamen previously captured each be given money and shoes and released to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, an edict ordered that each of the more than a hundred Hedong militiamen already captured be given money and shoes and sent back to their home districts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太子太師致仕安審暉卒。

translations.literal: On renzi, Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent An Shenhui died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, An Shenhui, Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，幸南莊，令從臣習射。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengshen, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and ordered his attendants to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and ordered his attendants to practice archery.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以樞密院直學士、左諫議大夫王溥為中書舍人，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: On wuchen, Wang Pu, Academician of the Privy Council and Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Secretariat Drafter and appointed Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Pu, Privy Council Academician and Left Remonstrance Counselor, was appointed Secretariat Drafter and Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 以內客省使、恩州團練使鄭仁誨為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Commissioner and En Prefecture militia commissioner Zheng Renhui was made Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Renhui, Inner Palace Commissioner and Militia Commissioner of En Prefecture, was made Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 詔宣徽北院使翟光鄴權知永興軍府事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered North Courtyard Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Zhai Guangye to act as administrator of Yongxing Military Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhai Guangye, North Courtyard Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, to serve as acting administrator of Yongxing Military Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔：「西京莊宅司、內侍省、宮苑司、內園等四司，所管諸巡系稅戶二千五百並還府縣。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict said: "The four offices of the Western Capital Estates Office, Inner Service Directorate, Palace Parks Office, and Inner Gardens, together with the 2,500 tax households under their patrol districts, are all to be returned to prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an edict said: "The four offices—the Western Capital Estates Office, Inner Service Directorate, Palace Parks Office, and Inner Gardens—together with the 2,500 tax households under their patrol districts, are all to be returned to prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 其廣德、升平二宮並停廢。

translations.literal: The Guangde and Shengping palaces are both to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangde and Shengping palaces are both to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 應行從諸莊園林、亭殿、房舍、什物課利，宜令逐司依舊收管。」

translations.literal: Revenues from estates, gardens, pavilions, halls, houses, and goods used by the imperial entourage should continue to be collected by each office as before."
translations.idiomatic: Income from the estates, gardens, pavilions, halls, dwellings, and goods that serve the imperial entourage should still be collected by each office according to former practice."

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，日有食之，帝避正殿，百官守司。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day, bingxu, there was an eclipse; the emperor avoided the main hall and the officials kept their posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon, bingxu, there was an eclipse; the emperor avoided the main hall and officials kept their posts.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔停蔡州鄉軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict halted the Cai Prefecture militia.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict halted the Cai Prefecture militia.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以京師旱，分命群臣禱雨。

translations.literal: On wuzi, because the capital was afflicted by drought, various ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, because the capital suffered drought, various ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，制削奪慕容彥超在身官爵。

translations.literal: On guisi, a decree stripped Murong Yanchao of all offices and ranks he held.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a decree stripped Murong Yanchao of all offices and ranks he held.

sentences.zh: 甲午，高麗國冊使、衛尉卿劉皞卒。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Liu Hao, envoy for the investiture of Goryeo and Minister of the Imperial Clan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Liu Hao, Goryeo investiture envoy and Minister of the Imperial Clan, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔取來月五日，車駕赴兗州城下，慰勞將士。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict set the fifth day of the coming month for the imperial carriage to go to Yan Prefecture below the walls to comfort the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict set the fifth day of the coming month for the imperial carriage to go below the walls of Yan Prefecture to comfort the troops.

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使鄭仁誨為右衛大將軍，依前充職，兼權大內都點檢；

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Zheng Renhui was made General of the Right Guard, continuing in his former post and also acting as overall inspector of the Inner Palace;
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Renhui, Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council, was made General of the Right Guard, continuing in his former post and also acting as overall inspector of the Inner Palace;

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事、判三司李穀為權東京留守，兼判開封府事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner of the Three Departments Li Gu was made acting Eastern Capital regent and also acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner of the Three Departments, was made acting Eastern Capital regent and also acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, bingchen, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall; guards and insignia followed the usual rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, bingchen, the emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall with guards and insignia as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the imperial carriage departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the imperial carriage departed the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至兗州城下。

translations.literal: On wuchen, it reached below the walls of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, it reached below the walls of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，收復兗州，斬慕容彥超，夷其族。

translations.literal: On yihai, Yan Prefecture was recovered; Murong Yanchao was beheaded and his clan exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yan Prefecture was retaken; Murong Yanchao was executed and his entire clan destroyed.

sentences.zh: 詔端明殿學士顏衎權知兗州軍州事。

translations.literal: An edict made Academician of the Duanming Hall Yan Yan acting military commissioner of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Yan Yan, Academician of the Duanming Hall, acting military commissioner of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬午，曲赦兗州管內罪人，取五月二十七日已前所犯罪，大辟已下，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On renwu, a partial amnesty was issued for criminals within Yan Prefecture's jurisdiction, taking crimes committed before the twenty-seventh day of the fifth month; from capital offenses down, all were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a partial amnesty was issued for criminals within Yan Prefecture, taking crimes committed before the twenty-seventh day of the fifth month; from capital offenses down, all were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 慕容彥超徒黨，有逃避潛竄者，及城內將吏等並放罪。

translations.literal: Followers of Murong Yanchao who had fled and hidden, and officers and clerks within the city, were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Those among Murong Yanchao's followers who had fled and gone into hiding, together with officers and clerks inside the city, were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 自慕容彥超違背以來，鄉州內有接便為非者，一切不問。

translations.literal: Since Murong Yanchao's rebellion, anyone in the countryside who had taken advantage to do wrong was not to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Since Murong Yanchao's defection, anyone in the countryside who had seized the moment to commit wrongdoing was not to be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 諸軍將士歿於王事者，各與賻贈，都頭已上與贈官。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers who died in the king's service each received funeral gifts; company heads and above received posthumous offices.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers who died in the service of the throne each received burial subsidies; unit heads and above were granted posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 兗州城內及官軍下寨四面去州五里內，今年所征夏秋稅及沿征錢物並放；

translations.literal: Within five li of Yan city and the army camps on all four sides, this year's summer and autumn taxes and all levied monies were remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Within five li of Yan city and of the army camps on all four sides, this year's summer and autumn taxes and all additional levies were waived;

sentences.zh: 十里內，只放夏稅；

translations.literal: within ten li, only the summer tax was remitted;
translations.idiomatic: within ten li, only the summer tax was remitted;

sentences.zh: 一州管界，今夏苗子三分放一分。

translations.literal: throughout the prefecture's jurisdiction, one-third of this summer's seed tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: throughout the prefecture's jurisdiction, one-third of this summer's seed tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 城內百姓遭毀拆舍屋及遭燒焚者，給賜材木。

translations.literal: Commoners in the city whose houses were destroyed or burned were given timber.
translations.idiomatic: City residents whose dwellings had been torn down or burned were given building timber.

sentences.zh: 諸處差到人夫內，有遭矢石死者，各給絹三匹，仍放戶下三年徭役雲。

translations.literal: Among corvée laborers drafted from various places who were killed by arrows and stones, each family was given three bolts of silk and exempted from three years of household corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Among the corvée laborers drafted from various districts who died from arrows and stones, each household received three bolts of silk and was exempted from three years of labor service.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔兗州降為防禦州，仍為望州。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict reduced Yan Prefecture to a defense prefecture, while still ranking it a premier prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict reduced Yan Prefecture to a defense prefecture while still ranking it a premier prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉朔，帝幸曲阜縣，謁孔子祠。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, yiyou, the emperor visited Qufu County and paid respects at the temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, yiyou, the emperor visited Qufu County and paid respects at the temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 既奠，將致拜，左右曰：「仲尼，人臣也，無致拜。

translations.literal: After the offering, as he was about to perform a bow, those at his side said: "Zhongni was a subject; there should be no bow.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering, as he was about to bow, those at his side said: "Zhongni was a subject; there should be no bow.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「文宣王，百代帝王師也，得無敬乎！

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The Cultured Sage King is teacher to emperors for a hundred generations — how could one not show respect!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "The Cultured Sage King has been the teacher of emperors through a hundred generations — how could one fail to show him reverence!

sentences.zh: 」即拜奠於祠前。

translations.literal: " He then bowed and made offering before the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: " He then bowed and made offering before the shrine.

sentences.zh: 其所奠酒器、銀爐並留於祠所。

translations.literal: The libation vessels and silver censers he had offered were all left at the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: The libation vessels and silver censers he had offered were all left at the shrine.

sentences.zh: 遂幸孔林，拜孔子墓。

translations.literal: Then he visited the Kong Forest and bowed at Confucius's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He then visited the Kong Forest and bowed at Confucius's tomb.

sentences.zh: 帝謂近臣曰：「仲尼、亞聖之後，今有何人？

translations.literal: The emperor said to those near him: "Among the descendants of Zhongni, the Secondary Sage, who is there now?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to those near him: "Among the descendants of Zhongni, the Secondary Sage, who remains today?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「前曲阜令、襲文宣公孔仁玉，是仲尼四十三代孫；

translations.literal: " They replied: "The former magistrate of Qufu, inheritor Duke of Cultured Propagation Kong Renyu, is the forty-third-generation descendant of Zhongni;
translations.idiomatic: " They answered: "The former magistrate of Qufu, Kong Renyu, who inherited the title Duke of Cultured Propagation, is the forty-third-generation descendant of Zhongni;

sentences.zh: 有鄉貢《三禮》顏涉，是顏淵之後。

translations.literal: there is Yan She, who submitted the 《Three Rites》 through the provincial examination, a descendant of Yan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: there is also Yan She, who presented the Three Rites by provincial examination and is a descendant of Yan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 」即召見。

translations.literal: " They were immediately summoned for audience.
translations.idiomatic: " They were immediately summoned for audience.

sentences.zh: 仁玉賜緋，口授曲阜令，顏涉授主簿，便令視事。

translations.literal: Renyu was granted scarlet robes and orally appointed magistrate of Qufu; Yan She was appointed chief clerk, and they were immediately ordered to take up their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Renyu was granted scarlet robes and orally appointed magistrate of Qufu; Yan She was appointed chief clerk, and both were immediately ordered to take up their duties.

sentences.zh: 仍敕兗州修葺孔子祠宇，墓側禁樵采。

translations.literal: An order was also issued to Yan Prefecture to repair the temple buildings of Confucius and to forbid woodcutting and gathering beside the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: An order was also issued to Yan Prefecture to repair Confucius's temple buildings and to forbid woodcutting and foraging beside the tomb.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕還京。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，帝以五月十三日至兗州，賊尚拒守，至十七日，晝夢道士一人進書，卷首云「車駕來月二日還京」，其下文字絕多，不能盡記。

translations.literal: Earlier, the emperor had reached Yan Prefecture on the thirteenth day of the fifth month while the rebels still held out in defense. On the seventeenth, in a daytime dream a Taoist presented a book; at the head of the scroll it read, "The imperial carriage will return to the capital on the second day of next month," and the text below was exceedingly long — it could not all be remembered.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the emperor had reached Yan Prefecture on the thirteenth day of the fifth month while the rebels still held out. On the seventeenth, in a daytime dream a Taoist presented a book whose opening line read, "The imperial carriage will return to the capital on the second day of next month"; the text below was exceedingly long and could not all be remembered.

sentences.zh: 既寤，以夢告宰臣，又四日而城拔。

translations.literal: When he awoke, he told the chief ministers of the dream; four days later the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: When he awoke, he told the chief ministers of the dream; four days later the city fell.

sentences.zh: 帝至軍，凡駐蹕九日而賊平，果以六月二日發離城下，近代親征克捷，無如此之速也。

translations.literal: From the emperor's arrival at the army until the rebels were pacified, he halted his progress for nine days in all; he indeed set out from below the city walls on the second day of the sixth month. In recent generations no personal campaign had achieved victory so swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: From the emperor's arrival at the army until the rebels were pacified, he halted his progress for nine days in all and indeed departed from below the city walls on the second day of the sixth month. In recent times no personal campaign had won victory so swiftly.

sentences.zh: 是日大雨，城下行宮，水深數尺。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy rain; at the traveling palace below the city, the water was several feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: That day brought heavy rain; at the traveling palace below the city, the water stood several feet deep.

sentences.zh: 其日晚，至中都縣，帝笑謂侍臣曰：「今日若不離城下，則當為潦所溺矣。

translations.literal: That evening, upon reaching Zhongdu County, the emperor smiled and said to his attendants: "Had we not left below the city today, we would have been drowned by the floodwaters.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, upon reaching Zhongdu County, the emperor smiled and said to his attendants: "Had we not left below the city today, we would have been drowned in the flood.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，車駕至自兗州。

translations.literal: " On wuxu, the imperial carriage arrived from Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuxu, the imperial carriage arrived from Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以靈武節度使馮暉卒，輟視朝一日。

translations.literal: On xinchou, because Lingwu military commissioner Feng Hui had died, court audiences were suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, because Lingwu Military Commissioner Feng Hui had died, court audiences were suspended for one day.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，前翰林學士李澣自契丹中上表，陳奏機事，且言偽幽州節度使蕭海貞欲謀向化，帝甚嘉之。

translations.literal: On renyin, the former Hanlin Academician Li Huan submitted a memorial from among the Khitan, setting forth urgent affairs and saying that the false Youzhou military commissioner Xiao Haizhen wished to plan defection to the Zhou; the emperor greatly commended him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the former Hanlin Academician Li Huan submitted a memorial from Khitan territory, reporting urgent affairs and saying that the false Youzhou Military Commissioner Xiao Haizhen planned to defect to the Zhou; the emperor greatly commended him.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·李澣傳》：海貞與澣相善，澣乘間諷海貞以南歸之計，海貞納之。

translations.literal: (From the Song History, Biography of Li Huan: Haizhen and Huan were on good terms; Huan took an opportune moment to hint to Haizhen a plan to return south, and Haizhen accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Song History》, Biography of Li Huan: Haizhen and Huan were on good terms; Huan took an opportune moment to suggest to Haizhen a plan to return south, and Haizhen accepted it.

sentences.zh: 周廣順二年，澣因定州孫方諫密表，言契丹衰微之勢，周祖嘉焉，遣諜者田重霸賫詔慰撫，仍命浣通信。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, Huan sent a secret memorial through Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture describing the Khitan's decline; the Zhou founder commended this and sent the spy Tian Chongba bearing an edict of consolation and reassurance, also ordering Huan to maintain correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou Guangshun year 2, Huan sent a secret memorial through Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture describing the Khitan's decline; the Zhou founder commended this, sent the spy Tian Chongba bearing an edict of consolation and reassurance, and ordered Huan to maintain correspondence.

sentences.zh: 澣復表述：「契丹主幼弱多寵，好擊鞠，大臣離貳，若出師討伐，因與通好，乃其時也。

translations.literal: Huan again memorialized: "The Khitan ruler is young and weak, overly indulged, and fond of cuju; the great ministers are divided. If we march out to chastise them and at the same time open friendly relations, this would be the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Huan memorialized again: "The Khitan ruler is young, weak, and over-favored; he loves to play cuju, and his great ministers are split. If we march out to chastise them while opening friendly relations at the same time, now is the time.

sentences.zh: 」屬中原多故，不能用其言。）〉

translations.literal: " But the Central Plain was beset by many troubles, and his advice could not be adopted.)
translations.idiomatic: " But the Central Plain was beset by many troubles, and his advice could not be adopted.)

sentences.zh: 癸卯，德妃董氏薨。

translations.literal: On guimao, Virtuous Consort Dong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Virtuous Consort Dong died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔宣徽南院使袁鳷判開封府事。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict appointed Southern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Yuan Zhi to oversee Kaifeng prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict appointed Yuan Zhi, Southern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, to oversee Kaifeng prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以朔方軍衙內都虞候馮繼業起復為朔方軍兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Feng Jiye, chief adjutant within the Shuofang army headquarters, was recalled from mourning to serve as military administrator of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Feng Jiye, Chief Adjutant within the Shuofang Army headquarters, was recalled from mourning to serve as Military Administrator of Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸舊宅，為德妃舉哀故也。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the emperor visited his old residence, because mourning was being held for Virtuous Consort Dong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the emperor visited his old residence to mourn Virtuous Consort Dong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔：「內外臣僚，每遇永壽節，舊設齋供。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the seventh month, bingchen, an edict: "Inner and outer officials, whenever the Eternal Longevity Festival occurred, formerly set out vegetarian offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingchen, an edict read: "Civil and military officials at court and in the provinces, whenever the Eternal Longevity Festival came around, had customarily set out vegetarian offerings.

sentences.zh: 今後中書門下與文武百官共設一齋，侍衛親軍都指揮使已下共設一齋，樞密使、內諸司使已下共設一齋，其餘前任職員及諸司職掌，更不得開設道場及設齋。

translations.literal: Henceforth the Secretariat-Chancellery and civil and military officials together are to set one offering; the Imperial Guard commander and those below together one offering; the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner and palace commissioners and those below together one offering. Former officeholders and various bureau functionaries may no longer establish ritual sites or set offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth the Secretariat-Chancellery and civil and military officials together shall set one offering; the Imperial Guard Commander and those below together one offering; the Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner, palace commissioners, and those below together one offering. Former officeholders and various bureau functionaries may no longer establish ritual sites or set offerings.

sentences.zh: 」是日大風雨，破屋拔樹，尚書省都堂有龍穿屋壞獸角而去，西壁有爪跡存焉。

translations.literal: " That day a great wind and rainstorm destroyed houses and uprooted trees; in the main hall of the Ministry of Revenue a dragon pierced the roof, broke off a beast-horn ornament, and departed; claw marks remained on the west wall.
translations.idiomatic: " That day a great wind and rainstorm destroyed houses and uprooted trees; in the main hall of the Ministry of Revenue a dragon pierced the roof, broke off a beast-horn ornament, and departed, leaving claw marks on the west wall.

sentences.zh: 襄州大水。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Prefecture suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔復升陳州、曹州為節鎮。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict restored Chen and Cao prefectures to military commission status.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict restored Chen and Cao prefectures to military commission status.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、洋州節度使郭崇為陳州節度使，以侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英為曹州節度使，並典軍如故。

translations.literal: Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Yangzhou military commissioner Guo Chong was made Chenzhou military commissioner; Imperial Guard infantry commander Cao Ying was made Caozhou military commissioner; both continued to command their armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chong, Commander of the Imperial Guard Cavalry and Military Commissioner of Yangzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Chenzhou; Cao Ying, Commander of the Imperial Guard Infantry, was made Military Commissioner of Caozhou; both continued to command their armies as before.

sentences.zh: 以陳州防禦使藥元福為晉州節度使。

translations.literal: Chen Prefecture defense commissioner Yao Yuanfu was made Jinzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanfu, Defense Commissioner of Chen Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔相州節度使李筠權知潞州軍州事。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict made Xiangzhou military commissioner Li Jun provisional administrator of Luzhou military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict made Li Jun, Military Commissioner of Xiangzhou, provisional administrator of Luzhou military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以小底都指揮使、漢州刺史李重進為大內都點檢兼馬步都軍頭，領恩州團練使；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Lower Guards commander and Hanzhou prefect Li Chongjin was made chief inspector of the Inner Palace and head of the horse-and-foot armies, while holding office as Enzhou militia commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Chongjin, Commander of the Lower Guards and Prefect of Hanzhou, was made Chief Inspector of the Inner Palace and Head of the Horse-and-Foot Armies, while holding office as Militia Commissioner of Enzhou;

sentences.zh: 以內殿直都知、駙馬都尉張永德領和州刺史，充小底第一軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Direct chief Zhang Yongde, imperial son-in-law, was appointed prefect of Hezhou and made commander of the First Lower Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yongde, Chief of the Inner Palace Direct and Imperial Son-in-Law, was appointed Prefect of Hezhou and made Commander of the First Lower Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申朔，翰林學士、刑部尚書張沆落職守本官。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, jiashen, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Justice Zhang Hong was removed from office but retained his nominal post.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, jiashen, Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Justice, was removed from office but retained his nominal post.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人、史館修撰判館事徐臺符為禮部尚書，充翰林學士承旨；

translations.literal: Zhongshu Sheren and Historiography Compiler, acting director of the Historiography Office, Xu Taifu was made Minister of Rites and Hanlin Academician Expositor;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu, Secretariat Drafter and Historiography Compiler acting as Director of the Historiography Office, was made Minister of Rites and Hanlin Academician Expositor;

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎韋勛為尚書右丞；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Wei Xun was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xun, Vice Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 以尚書右丞於德辰為吏部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Yu Dechen was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: Yu Dechen, Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎邊歸讜為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Bian Guidan was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guidan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎趙上交為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Zhao Shangjiao was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、左散騎常侍陳觀為工部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs Academician and Left Regular Attendant Chen Guan was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former post;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan, Bureau of Military Affairs Academician and Left Regular Attendant, was made Vice Minister of Works while continuing in his former post;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎景範為左司郎中，充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Jing Fan was made Left Section Director and made Bureau of Military Affairs Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Left Section Director and Bureau of Military Affairs Academician.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，樞密使王峻上章，請解樞衡，凡三上章，詔不允。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Wang Jun submitted a memorial requesting release from the pivot of state; thrice he submitted, and thrice the edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, submitted a memorial requesting release from the pivot of state; he submitted three times, and each time the edict refused.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，潁州奏，先於淮南俘獲孳畜，已準詔送還本土。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Ying Prefecture reported that livestock seized earlier in Huainan had been returned to their native regions according to edict.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Ying Prefecture reported that livestock captured earlier in Huainan had been returned to their native regions according to edict.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔止絕吏民詣闕舉請刺史、縣令。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict forbade officials and commoners from coming to court to petition for the appointment of prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an edict forbade officials and commoners from coming to the capital to recommend candidates for prefect and magistrate appointments.

sentences.zh: 賜宰臣李穀白藤肩輿。

translations.literal: Chief minister Li Gu was granted a palanquin of white rattan.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Li Gu was granted a palanquin of white rattan.

sentences.zh: 時穀以今年七月，因步履傷臂，請告數旬，詔穀扶持三司，刻名印署事，仍放朝參。

translations.literal: At the time Gu, in the seventh month of that year, had injured his arm while walking and requested leave for several ten-day periods; an edict allowed Gu, supported, to oversee the Three Departments, signing affairs with his engraved seal name, and excused him from court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Gu, in the seventh month of that year, had injured his arm while walking and requested leave for several ten-day periods; an edict allowed Gu, though supported, to oversee the Three Departments, signing affairs with his engraved seal name, and excused him from court attendance.

sentences.zh: 庚子，潞州節度使常思移鎮宋州，相州節度使李筠移鎮潞州。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Luzhou military commissioner Chang Si was transferred to Song Prefecture; Xiangzhou military commissioner Li Jun was transferred to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Chang Si, Military Commissioner of Luzhou, was transferred to Song Prefecture; Li Jun, Military Commissioner of Xiangzhou, was transferred to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄆州節度使高行周薨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Yunzhou military commissioner Gao Xingzhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Yunzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔改鹽曲法，鹽曲犯五斤已上處死，煎鹼鹽者犯一斤已上處死。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict revised the salt-yeast law: those guilty of salt yeast in five jin or more were executed; those guilty of boiling alkaline salt in one jin or more were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict revised the salt-yeast law: those guilty of possessing five jin or more of salt yeast were executed, and those guilty of boiling one jin or more of alkaline salt were executed.

sentences.zh: 先是，漢法不計斤兩多少，並處極刑，至是始革之。

translations.literal: Earlier, under Han law no account was taken of weight; all were punished with the extreme penalty; only now was this changed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, under Han law weight was not counted and all offenders were punished with the extreme penalty; only now was this changed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，以大理卿劇可久為太僕卿，以左庶子張仁彖為大理卿，以司天監趙延乂為太府卿兼判司天監事。

translations.literal: On the ninth month, gengwu, Court Director of Punishments Ju Kejiu was made Court Director of the Imperial Stud; Left Household Companion Zhang Renbiao was made Court Director of Punishments; Astronomical Bureau Director Zhao Yanyi was made Court Director of the Imperial Treasury and acting director of the Astronomical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Ju Kejiu, Court Director of Punishments, was made Court Director of the Imperial Stud; Zhang Renbiao, Left Household Companion, was made Court Director of Punishments; Zhao Yanyi, Director of the Astronomical Bureau, was made Court Director of the Imperial Treasury and acting Director of the Astronomical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 詔北面沿邊州鎮，自守疆埸，不得入北界俘掠。

translations.literal: An edict to northern frontier prefectures and commissions: defend your borders on your own; do not enter the northern territory to carry off plunder.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to northern frontier prefectures and commissions ordered them to defend their own borders and forbade entering the northern territory to carry off plunder.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，鎮州奏，契丹寇深、冀州，遣龍捷都指揮使劉誨、牙內都指揮使何繼筠等率兵拒之而退。

translations.literal: On yihai, Zhen Prefecture reported that Khitan raided Shen and Ji prefectures; Dragon Swift commander Liu Hui, Inner Guard commander He Jijun, and others led troops to resist and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhen Prefecture reported that Khitan raided Shen and Ji prefectures; Liu Hui, Commander of the Dragon Swift Army, He Jijun, Inner Guard Commander, and others led troops to resist and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 時契丹聞官軍至，掠冀部丁壯數百隨行，狼狽而北，冀部被擄者望見官軍，鼓噪不已，官軍不敢進，其丁壯盡為蕃軍所殺而去。

translations.literal: At the time, when the Khitan heard that the imperial army had arrived, they carried off several hundred strong men from Ji Prefecture as they went north in disorder; the captives from Ji Prefecture, seeing the imperial army, clamored without cease, but the imperial army dared not advance, and the strong men were all killed by the barbarian army and left behind.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, when the Khitan heard that the imperial army had arrived, they carried off several hundred strong men from Ji Prefecture as they fled north in disorder. The captives from Ji Prefecture, seeing the imperial army, clamored without cease, but the imperial army dared not advance, and the strong men were all killed by the barbarian army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以鄭州防禦使白重贊為相州留後。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner Bai Chongzan was made acting administrator of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Bai Chongzan, Defense Commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made Acting Administrator of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樂壽都監杜延熙奏，於瀛州南殺敗契丹，斬首三百級，獲馬四十七匹。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Lesou supervisor Du Yanxi reported that south of Ying Prefecture he had defeated Khitan, beheading three hundred and capturing forty-seven horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Du Yanxi, Supervisor of Lesou, reported that south of Ying Prefecture he had defeated Khitan, beheading three hundred and capturing forty-seven horses.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝姨母韓氏追封楚國夫人，故第四姊追封福慶長公主。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the emperor's maternal aunt Lady Han was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of the State of Chu, and the late fourth elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Long Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the emperor's maternal aunt, Lady Han, was posthumously made Lady of the State of Chu, and his deceased fourth elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Long Celebration.

sentences.zh: 癸未，易州奏，契丹武州刺史石越來奔。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Yi Prefecture reported that Shijun, Military Commissioner of Wuzhou under the Khitan, came to defect.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yi Prefecture reported that Shi Yue, Military Commissioner of Wuzhou under the Khitan, had come to defect.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，以前晉州節度使王彥超為河陽節度使。

translations.literal: On the tenth month, winter, bingxu, former Jinzhou military commissioner Wang Yanchao was made Heyang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the tenth month of winter, Wang Yanchao, former Military Commissioner of Jinzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔：「諸州罷任或朝覲，並不得以器械進貢。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict: "When prefects leave office or come to court, they may not present weapons as tribute."
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict declared: "When prefects leave their posts or come to court, they may not offer weapons as tribute."

sentences.zh: 」先是，諸道州府，各有作院，每月課造軍器，逐季搬送京師進納。

translations.literal: Earlier, each circuit and prefecture had its own workshops, which every month were tasked to manufacture military equipment and every quarter transported it to the capital for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, each circuit and prefecture maintained its own workshops, charged every month with making military equipment and every quarter sending it to the capital as tribute.

sentences.zh: 其逐州每年占留系省錢帛不少，謂之「甲料」，仍更於部內廣配土產物，征斂數倍，民甚苦之。

translations.literal: Each prefecture every year retained no small amount of provincial funds and goods, called "armor-material" quotas, and further widely assessed local products within its jurisdiction, collecting several times the amount; the people suffered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Every year each prefecture held back a considerable portion of provincial funds and goods under what were called "armor-material" quotas, then imposed broad assessments on local products within its territory, collecting several times the proper amount; the people bore the burden bitterly.

sentences.zh: 除上供軍器外，節度使、刺史又私造器甲，以進貢為名，功費又倍，悉取之於民。

translations.literal: Apart from military equipment supplied to the court, military commissioners and prefects also privately made armor and weapons, using tribute as a pretext; the labor and expense were again doubled, all taken from the people.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from military equipment supplied to the court, military commissioners and prefects also privately made armor and weapons under the pretext of tribute; the labor and expense were again doubled, all taken from the people.

sentences.zh: 帝以諸州器甲造作不精，兼占留屬省物用過當，乃令罷之。

translations.literal: Because the armor and weapons made in the various prefectures were not finely crafted and because provincial goods were excessively retained, the emperor ordered this stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Because armor and weapons made in the various prefectures were poorly crafted and provincial goods were excessively retained, the emperor ordered this stopped.

sentences.zh: 仍選擇諸道作工，赴京作坊，以備役使。

translations.literal: Skilled craftsmen from the various circuits were also selected and sent to the capital workshops to be available for service.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled artisans from the circuits were also chosen and sent to the capital workshops to serve when needed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，永興軍奏，宣徽北院使、知軍府事翟光鄴卒。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Yongxing Circuit reported that Northern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Zhai Guangye, who administered the military prefecture, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yongxing Circuit reported that Zhai Guangye, Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service and Administrator of the Military Prefecture, had died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，葬德妃，廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Virtuous Consort Dong was buried and court audiences were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Virtuous Consort Dong was buried and court audiences were suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以宣徽南院使袁鳷權知永興軍府事，以樞密直學士、工部侍郎陳觀權知開封府事。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Southern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Yuan Zhi was made provisional administrator of Yongxing military prefectural affairs; Bureau of Military Affairs Academician and Vice Minister of Works Chen Guan was made provisional administrator of Kaifeng prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yuan Zhi, Southern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, was made provisional administrator of Yongxing military prefectural affairs; Chen Guan, Bureau of Military Affairs Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made provisional administrator of Kaifeng prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，升鉅野縣為濟州。

translations.literal: On jihai, Juye County was elevated to Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Juye County was elevated to Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以樞密院副使鄭仁誨為宣徽北院使兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Zheng Renhui was made Northern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Renhui, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸樞密院，王峻請之也。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the emperor visited the Bureau of Military Affairs at Wang Jun's request.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the emperor visited the Bureau of Military Affairs at Wang Jun's request.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宰臣李穀以臂傷未愈，上表辭位，凡三上章，詔報不允。

translations.literal: On jiachen, chief minister Li Gu, his arm injury not yet healed, submitted a memorial resigning his post; thrice he submitted, and thrice the edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Chief Minister Li Gu, his arm injury not yet healed, submitted a memorial resigning his post; he submitted three times, and each time the edict refused.

sentences.zh: 丁未，滄州奏，自十月已前，蕃歸漢戶萬九千八百戶。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Cang Prefecture reported that before the tenth month, nineteen thousand eight hundred households of barbarians had returned to Han allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cang Prefecture reported that by the tenth month, nineteen thousand eight hundred barbarian households had returned to Han allegiance.

sentences.zh: 是時，北境饑謹，人民轉徙，繈負而歸中土者，散居河北州縣，凡數十萬口。

translations.literal: At the time the northern frontier suffered famine; people migrated, and those who returned to the Central Plain carrying infants on their backs were scattered through the prefectures and counties of Hebei, numbering altogether several hundred thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: At that time famine ravaged the northern frontier. People drifted from place to place, and those who made their way back to the Central Plain with infants strapped to their backs were scattered across the prefectures and counties of Hebei — altogether several hundred thousand souls.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，荊南奏，朗州大將劉言，以今年十月三日領兵趨長沙，十五日至潭州，淮南所署湖南節度使邊鎬、岳州刺史宋德權並棄城遁去。

translations.literal: On the eleventh month, bingchen, Jingnan reported that Liu Yan, a great general of Lang Prefecture, on the third day of the tenth month of this year led troops toward Changsha, reached Tan Prefecture on the fifteenth, and that Bian Hao, Hunan military commissioner appointed by Huainan, and Yuezhou prefect Song Dequan both abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month, Jingnan reported that Liu Yan, a great general of Lang Prefecture, on the third day of the tenth month of this year had led troops toward Changsha, reached Tan Prefecture on the fifteenth, and that Bian Hao, Hunan Military Commissioner appointed by Huainan, and Song Dequan, Prefect of Yuezhou, had both abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前少府監馬從斌為殿中監。

translations.literal: On gengshen, former Vice Director of the Palace Manufactories Ma Congbin was made Director of the Palace Receptions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Ma Congbin, former Vice Director of the Palace Manufactories, was made Director of the Palace Receptions.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，樞密使王峻亡妻崔氏追封趙國夫人，非故事也。

translations.literal: On renxu, Wang Jun's deceased wife Lady Cui was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of the State of Zhao — without precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wang Jun's late wife, Lady Cui, was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of the State of Zhao — a break with precedent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，刑部尚書張沆卒。

translations.literal: On yichou, Minister of Justice Zhang Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Hong, Minister of Justice, died.

translations.literal: On xinwei, Shaan Prefecture's Zhe Congruan was transferred to Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhe Congruan of Shaan Prefecture was transferred to Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以前宋州節度使李洪義為安州節度使。

translations.literal: Former Songzhou military commissioner Li Hongyi was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongyi, former Military Commissioner of Songzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，青州符彥卿移鎮鄆州。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Qingzhou's Fu Yanqing was transferred to Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Fu Yanqing of Qingzhou was transferred to Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「累朝已來，用兵不息，至於繕治甲胄，未免配役生靈，多取於民，助成軍器。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict said: "From dynasty to dynasty warfare has not ceased; in repairing armor and helmets, corvée laborers have inevitably been conscripted from the people, much taken from the populace to supply military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict read: "From one dynasty to the next warfare has never ceased. In repairing armor and helmets, the state has inevitably conscripted the people, taking heavily from the populace to furnish military equipment.

sentences.zh: 就中皮革，尤峻科刑，稍犯嚴條，皆抵極典，鄉縣以之生事，奸猾得以侵漁，宜立新規，用革前弊。

translations.literal: Among these, leather was especially subject to harsh penalties; the slightest violation of strict statutes met the extreme punishment, and counties and districts used this to create trouble while the cunning exploited the people. A new regulation should be established to reform former abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Leather was the worst of these: the slightest breach of the strict code brought the harshest penalty. County and district officials used this to stir up trouble, and the cunning preyed on the people. New rules should be set down to abolish these old abuses.

sentences.zh: 應天下所納牛皮，今將逐所納數，三分內減二分，其一分於人戶苗畝上配定。

translations.literal: Of all hide presented throughout the empire, two-thirds of the amount presented at each place shall now be reduced, with the remaining third assessed per household according to seed acreage.
translations.idiomatic: Of all cattle hide delivered throughout the empire, two-thirds of what each place had been required to present would now be cut, and the remaining third would be assigned household by household according to cultivated acreage.

sentences.zh: 每秋夏苗共十頃納連角皮一張，其黃牛納幹筋四兩，水牛半斤，犢子皮不在納限。

translations.literal: Each summer and autumn ten qing of seed acreage shall present one hide with horns attached; for yellow cattle, four liang of dried sinew shall be presented, for water buffalo half a jin; calf hide is not within the quota.
translations.idiomatic: For every ten qing of cultivated land, one hide with horns attached would be due each spring and autumn; for yellow cattle, four liang of dried sinew; for water buffalo, half a jin. Calf hide lay outside the quota.

sentences.zh: 牛馬驢騾皮筋角，今後官中更不禁斷，只不得將出化外敵境。

translations.literal: Hide, sinew, and horn of cattle, horses, donkeys, and mules shall no longer be forbidden by the court, but may not be taken out beyond the border to enemy territory.
translations.idiomatic: Hide, sinew, and horn from cattle, horses, donkeys, and mules would no longer be banned by the court, but could not be carried beyond the frontier into enemy lands.

sentences.zh: 州縣先置巡檢牛皮節級並停。

translations.literal: The hide-inspection patrol officers and grades previously established in prefectures and counties are abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The hide-inspection patrol officers and grades previously established in prefectures and counties are abolished.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，詔曰：「應內外文武官僚幕職、州縣官舉選人等，今後有父母、祖父母亡歿未經遷葬者，其主家之長，不得輒求仕進，所由司亦不得申舉解送。

translations.literal: " On bingzi, an edict said: "For all inner and outer civil and military officials, staff appointees, and prefectural and county officials and examination candidates, hereafter if parents or grandparents have died and not yet been reburied, the head of the household may not seek advancement, and the responsible office may not recommend or forward them.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi, an edict declared: "For all civil and military officials, staff appointees, prefectural and county officers, and examination candidates at court and in the provinces, if from now on parents or grandparents have died and have not yet been reburied, the head of the household may not seek office, nor may the responsible office recommend or forward his candidacy.

sentences.zh: 如是卑幼在下者，不在此限。

translations.literal: If they are younger members lower in the household, this limit does not apply."
translations.idiomatic: If they are younger members lower in the household, this limit does not apply."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: " On jimao, the winter solstice, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and honors followed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao, the winter solstice, the emperor ascended Chongyuan Hall to receive the court's congratulations; guards and ceremonial honors followed the prescribed rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，權武平軍留後劉言遣牙將張崇嗣入奏，於十月十三日，與節度副使王進逵、行軍司馬何敬貞、指揮使周行逢等，同共部領戰棹，攻收湖南，偽節度使邊鎬當夜出奔，王進逵等已入潭州。

translations.literal: On the twelfth month, bingxu, Acting Administrator of Wuping Army Liu Yan sent his adjutant Zhang Chongsi to report that on the thirteenth day of the tenth month he, together with Vice Military Commissioner Wang Jinkui, Chief of Staff He Jingzhen, and Commander Zhou Xingfeng and others, jointly led war vessels to attack and recover Hunan; the false military commissioner Bian Hao fled by night, and Wang Jinkui and the others had already entered Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the twelfth month, Liu Yan, Acting Administrator of Wuping Army, sent his adjutant Zhang Chongsi to report that on the thirteenth day of the tenth month he, together with Vice Military Commissioner Wang Jinkui, Chief of Staff He Jingzhen, and Commander Zhou Xingfeng and others, had jointly led war vessels to attack and recover Hunan; the false Military Commissioner Bian Hao fled by night, and Wang Jinkui and the others had already entered Tan Prefecture.
