translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《九國誌·王逵傳》：逵，朗州武陵人，或名進逵。

translations.literal: (From the Record of the Nine States, Biography of Wang Kui: Kui was a native of Wuling in Lang Prefecture, also called Jinkui.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Record of the Nine States》, Biography of Wang Kui: Kui was a native of Wuling in Lang Prefecture, also called Jinkui.

sentences.zh: 邊鎬為武安軍節度使，召劉言入覲，言不行，謀於逵曰：「江南召我，不往，必加兵於我矣，為之奈何！

translations.literal: Bian Hao was military commissioner of Wu'an Army and summoned Liu Yan to court; Yan would not go and consulted Kui, saying: "The Jiangnan court summons me; if I do not go, they will surely send troops against me. What is to be done!
translations.idiomatic: Bian Hao was Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army and summoned Liu Yan to court; Yan would not go and consulted Kui, saying: "The Jiangnan court summons me; if I do not go, they will surely send troops against me. What is to be done!

sentences.zh: 」逵曰：「鎬之此來，以制置潭、朗為名，公如速行，正入其算。

translations.literal: " Kui said: "Hao has come this time in the name of administering Tan and Lang; if you go quickly, you will fall exactly into his calculation.
translations.idiomatic: " Kui said: "Hao has come this time under the pretext of administering Tan and Lang. If you move swiftly, you will walk straight into his trap.

sentences.zh: 武陵負江湖之阻，帶甲百萬，乃欲拱手臣異姓乎？

translations.literal: Wuling lies behind the barrier of rivers and lakes and can field a million armored men — would you meekly submit as subject to a different surname?
translations.idiomatic: Wuling stands behind rivers and lakes that form a natural barrier and can put a million armed men in the field — yet you would meekly bow to a ruler of another surname?

sentences.zh: 鎬新至長沙，經略未定，乘人心憤怒，引兵攻鎬，可一鼓而擒也。

translations.literal: Hao has newly arrived at Changsha and his control is not yet settled; seize the people's anger, lead troops to attack Hao, and he can be captured in a single assault.
translations.idiomatic: Hao has only just reached Changsha and his grip is not yet secure. Strike while the people are angry, lead your troops against Hao, and you can take him in a single charge.

sentences.zh: 」言然之，乃遣與何景真等同起兵於武陵，號十指揮使，以攻邊鎬。

translations.literal: " Yan agreed and sent him together with He Jingzhen and others to raise troops at Wuling, styling themselves the Ten-Finger Commanders, to attack Bian Hao.
translations.idiomatic: " Yan assented and sent him, together with He Jingzhen and others, to raise troops at Wuling. They styled themselves the Ten-Finger Commanders and marched against Bian Hao.

sentences.zh: 逵率舟師南上，至長沙，邊鎬大駭，以所部奔歸江南，諸州屯守皆罷之，盡復湖外之地。）〉

translations.literal: Kui led the fleet south to Changsha. Bian Hao was greatly alarmed and fled with his forces back to Jiangnan; garrison posts in all prefectures were withdrawn, and lands beyond the lake were fully recovered.)
translations.idiomatic: Kui led the river fleet south to Changsha. Bian Hao was terrified and fled with his troops back to Jiangnan. Garrisons in every prefecture were pulled back, and all the lands beyond the lake were recovered.)

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太子太師致仕安叔千卒。

translations.literal: On guisi, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent An Shuqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, An Shuqian, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔今後諸侯入朝，不得進奉買宴。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict said that hereafter when feudatories came to court, they might not present gifts to purchase banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an edict declared that henceforth when feudatories came to court, they might not present gifts to purchase banquets.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇子澶州節度使榮落起復，加同平章事。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the prince, Military Commissioner of Chanzhou Rong, left mourning restoration and was made Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Prince Rong, Military Commissioner of Chanzhou, left mourning and resumed office, and was made Associate Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太子少傅致仕王延卒。

translations.literal: On wuxu, retired Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Yan, retired Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On renyin, the emperor visited West Manor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the emperor visited West Manor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以端明殿學士顏衎權知開封府事。

translations.literal: On yisi, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity Yan Kan was appointed acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yan Kan, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity, was appointed acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 御史臺奏：「請改左右衛復為左右屯衛。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "We request that Left and Right Guard be changed back to Left and Right Garrison Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate memorialized: "We ask that the Left and Right Guard be restored to their former names, Left and Right Garrison Guard.

sentences.zh: 」從之，避御名也。

translations.idiomatic: " Approved — to avoid the emperor's taboo name.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 廣順三年春正月壬子朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month, spring, Guangshun year 3, renzi, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and honors followed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month, spring, Guangshun year 3, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and honors followed the rites.

sentences.zh: 幸太平宮起居漢太后。

translations.literal: He visited Taiping Palace to inquire after the Han Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Taiping Palace to inquire after the Han Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜群臣射於內鞠場。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the emperor granted the ministers archery at the inner ball court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the emperor granted the ministers archery at the inner ball court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，武平軍兵馬留後劉言奏：「潭州干戈之後，焚燒殆盡，乞移使府於武陵。

translations.literal: On yimao, Liu Yan, Acting Administrator of Wuping Army, memorialized: "After the fighting at Tan Prefecture, the city was burned almost to nothing; we beg to move the commissionerate to Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liu Yan, Acting Administrator of Wuping Army, memorialized: "After the fighting at Tan Prefecture the city was burned nearly to ash. We beg leave to move the commissionerate to Wuling.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 詔升朗州為大都督府，在潭州之上。

translations.literal: An edict elevated Lang Prefecture to a great metropolitan prefecture, ranking above Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict raised Lang Prefecture to a great metropolitan prefecture, placing it above Tan Prefecture in rank.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以武平軍節度使留後、檢校太尉劉言為檢校太師、同平章事，行朗州大都督，充武平軍節度兼三司水陸轉運等使，制置武安、靜江等軍事，進封彭城郡公；

translations.literal: On bingchen, Liu Yan, Acting Administrator and Honorary Grand Guardian of Wuping Army, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor, Associate Grand Councilor, acting Metropolitan Prefect of Lang Prefecture, Military Commissioner of Wuping Army and Commissioner of the Three Departments' land and water transport services, with authority over Wu'an and Jingjiang military affairs, and was advanced to Duke of Pengcheng Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Liu Yan, Acting Administrator of Wuping Army and Honorary Grand Guardian, was appointed Honorary Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor, made acting Metropolitan Prefect of Lang, Military Commissioner of Wuping Army and Commissioner for the Three Departments' land and water transport, given authority over military affairs in Wu'an and Jingjiang, and advanced to Duke of Pengcheng Commandery;

sentences.zh: 武平軍節度副使、權知潭州軍州事、檢校太傅王進逵為檢校太尉，行潭州刺史，充武安軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wang Jinkui, Vice Military Commissioner of Wuping Army, acting administrator of Tan Prefecture, and Honorary Grand Mentor, was made Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Tan Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinkui, Vice Military Commissioner of Wuping Army, acting administrator of Tan, and Honorary Grand Mentor, was made Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Tan, and Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army;

sentences.zh: 以武安軍行軍司馬兼衙內步軍都指揮使、檢校太傅何敬貞為檢校太尉，行桂州刺史，充靜江軍節度使；

translations.literal: He Jingzhen, Chief of Staff of Wu'an Army and Commander of the Inner Step Army, Honorary Grand Mentor, was made Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Gui Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;
translations.idiomatic: He Jingzhen, Chief of Staff of Wu'an Army, Commander of the Inner Step Army, and Honorary Grand Mentor, was appointed Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Gui, and Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;

sentences.zh: 以張仿領眉州刺史，充武平軍節度副使；

translations.literal: Zhang Fang was made acting Prefect of Mei Prefecture and Vice Military Commissioner of Wuping Army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang was appointed acting Prefect of Mei and Vice Military Commissioner of Wuping Army;

sentences.zh: 以朱元琇領黃州刺史，充靜江軍節度副使；

translations.literal: Zhu Yuanxiu was made acting Prefect of Huang Prefecture and Vice Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yuanxiu was appointed acting Prefect of Huang and Vice Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;

sentences.zh: 以周行逢領集州刺史，充武安軍節度行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Zhou Xingfeng was made acting Prefect of Ji Prefecture and Chief of Staff of Wu'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xingfeng was appointed acting Prefect of Ji and Chief of Staff of Wu'an Army.

sentences.zh: 自進逵而下，皆劉言將校也。

translations.literal: From Jinkui downward, all were Liu Yan's officers.
translations.idiomatic: From Jinkui downward, all were Liu Yan's officers.

sentences.zh: 邠州奏，慶州略蕃部野雞族略奪商旅，侵擾州界。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture reported that the Yezi tribe of Qing Prefecture's frontier tribes had robbed merchants and raided the prefectural border.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Prefecture reported that the Yezi, a frontier tribe under Qing Prefecture, had robbed travelers and raided across the prefectural border.

sentences.zh: 詔遣寧州刺史張建武等率兵掩襲，仍先賜敕書安撫，如不從命，即進軍問罪。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Zhang Jianwu of Ning Prefecture and others to lead troops in a surprise attack, first sending an edict of reassurance; if they did not obey, troops were to advance and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Zhang Jianwu of Ning Prefecture and others to lead troops in a surprise strike, first dispatching a reassuring edict; if the tribe refused to comply, the army was to advance and punish them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔賜朗州劉言應兩京及諸道舊屬湖南樓店邸第。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict granted Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture the shops and mansions in the two capitals and along the circuits formerly belonging to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict granted Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture the shops and mansions in the two capitals and on the circuits that had formerly belonged to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：「諸道州府系屬戶部營田及租稅課利等，除京兆府莊宅務、贍國軍榷鹽務、兩京行從莊外，其餘並割屬州縣，所征租稅課利，官中只管舊額，其職員節級一切停廢。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict said: "Revenue from camp fields, taxes, and commercial levies attached to the Ministry of Revenue in prefectures and circuits throughout the empire — aside from the Estate Office of Jingzhao Prefecture, the Salt Monopoly Office of the Army Supporting the State, and the traveling estates of the two capitals — shall all be transferred to prefectures and counties. Taxes and commercial levies collected shall be limited by the old quotas; all staff ranks and grades are abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict declared: "Revenues from camp fields, taxes, and commercial levies under the Ministry of Revenue in prefectures and circuits throughout the empire — except for the Estate Office of Jingzhao Prefecture, the Salt Monopoly Office of the Army Supporting the State, and the traveling estates of the two capitals — shall all be transferred to prefectures and counties. Collected taxes and levies shall not exceed the old quotas, and all related staff ranks and grades are abolished.

sentences.zh: 應有客戶元佃系省莊田、桑土、舍宇，便賜逐戶，充為永業，仍仰縣司給與憑由。

translations.literal: Tenant clients who originally rented state estates, mulberry land, and buildings shall be granted them household by household as permanent property, and the county office shall issue certificates.
translations.idiomatic: Tenant clients who had long rented state estates, mulberry land, and buildings would receive them household by household as permanent property, with the county office issuing title certificates.

sentences.zh: 應諸處元屬營田戶部院及系縣人戶所納租中課利，起今年後並與除放。

translations.literal: Commercial levies within the rents paid by households formerly attached to camp-field offices of the Ministry of Revenue and to county households shall all be remitted from this year onward.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial levies embedded in the rents paid by households formerly tied to camp-field offices of the Ministry of Revenue and to county households would all be waived from this year on.

sentences.zh: 所有見牛犢並賜本戶，官中永不收系」云。

translations.literal: All existing oxen and calves shall be granted to their original households, and the court shall never reclaim them," it said.
translations.idiomatic: All oxen and calves currently in the system would be granted to their original households, and the court would never reclaim them," the edict said.

sentences.zh: 帝在民間，素知營田之弊，至是以天下系官莊田僅萬計，悉以分賜見佃戶充永業。

translations.literal: When the emperor had lived among the people, he had long known the abuses of camp fields; now state estates throughout the empire, numbering nearly ten thousand, were all divided and granted to current tenants as permanent property.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had known the abuses of camp fields since his days among the people. Now nearly ten thousand state estates throughout the empire were divided and granted outright to the tenants who worked them.

sentences.zh: 是歲出戶三萬餘，百姓既得為己業，比戶欣然，於是葺屋植樹，敢致功力。

translations.literal: That year more than thirty thousand households were released; once the people held land as their own, every household rejoiced, and they then repaired houses, planted trees, and dared to apply their labor.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than thirty thousand households were freed. Once the land was truly theirs, household after household rejoiced; people repaired their homes, planted trees, and at last dared invest their labor.

sentences.zh: 又，東南郡邑各有租牛課戶，往因梁太祖渡淮，軍士掠民牛以千萬計，梁太祖盡給與諸州民，輸租課，自是六十餘載，時移代改，牛租猶在，百姓苦之，至是特與除放。

translations.literal: Moreover, southeastern commanderies and districts each had rent-ox levy households. Formerly, when Emperor Taizu of Liang crossed the Huai, soldiers seized civilian oxen numbering in the millions; Emperor Taizu of Liang gave them all to the people of the various prefectures to pay rent levies. From then for more than sixty years, though dynasties changed, the ox rent remained, and the people suffered from it; now it was specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the southeastern commanderies and districts there were also rent-ox levy households. Long ago, when Emperor Taizu of Liang crossed the Huai, his soldiers had seized civilian oxen by the millions; the emperor then distributed them to the people of the various prefectures to meet rent obligations. For more than sixty years since, through changing dynasties, the ox rent had never been lifted, and the people suffered under it. Now it was specially waived.

sentences.zh: 未幾，京兆府莊宅務及榷鹽務亦歸州縣，依例處分。

translations.literal: Before long, the Estate Office of Jingzhao Prefecture and the Salt Monopoly Office also reverted to prefectures and counties and were handled according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, the Estate Office of Jingzhao Prefecture and the Salt Monopoly Office were also returned to prefectural and county control and administered according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 或有上言，以天下系官莊田，甚有可惜者，若遣貨之，當得三十萬緡，亦可資國用。

translations.literal: Some memorialized that state estates throughout the empire included many that were quite worth preserving; if sold, they might fetch three hundred thousand strings of cash, which could also support state expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Some memorialized that many state estates throughout the empire were far too valuable to waste; if sold, they might bring in three hundred thousand strings of cash and help fill the treasury.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「茍利於民，與資國何異。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If it benefits the people, how is that different from enriching the state.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "If it benefits the people, how is that different from enriching the state.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，戶部侍郎、權知貢舉趙上交奏：「諸科舉人，欲等第各加對義場數；

translations.literal: " On dingmao, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and Acting Examination Commissioner, memorialized: "Examination candidates in all categories should have additional oral-examination sessions according to rank;
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and Acting Examination Commissioner, memorialized: "Candidates in every examination category should, according to rank, be given additional oral-examination sessions;

sentences.zh: 進士除詩賦外，別試雜文一場。

translations.literal: For jinshi candidates, aside from poetry and fu, there should be an additional examination in miscellaneous prose.
translations.idiomatic: For jinshi candidates, aside from poetry and fu, there should be an additional examination in miscellaneous prose.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 兩浙吊祭使、左諫議大夫李知損責授登州司馬，員外置，仍令所在馳驛放遣。

translations.literal: Li Zhisun, Mourning Commissioner of the Two Zhes and Left Remonstrance Censor, was demoted to Regional Administrator of Deng Prefecture, appointed outside the regular roster, and ordered expelled by express relay from his place of assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhisun, Mourning Commissioner for the Two Zhes and Left Remonstrance Censor, was demoted to Regional Administrator of Deng Prefecture on an extra-statutory appointment and ordered expelled by urgent relay from wherever he was posted.

sentences.zh: 知損銜命江、浙，所經藩郡，皆強貸於侯伯，為青州知州張凝所奏，故有是命。

translations.literal: Zhisun had carried orders to the Jiang and Zhe region; in every feudal prefecture he passed through he forcibly borrowed from the regional lords. Prefect Zhang Ning of Qing Prefecture memorialized against him, and therefore this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Zhisun had been dispatched on imperial business to Jiang and Zhe; at every prefecture he passed through he extorted loans from the regional lords. Zhang Ning, Prefect of Qing, memorialized against him, and this order followed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On jisi, the emperor visited South Manor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the emperor visited South Manor.

sentences.zh: 臨水亭，見雙鳧戲於池上，帝引弓射之，一發疊貫，從臣稱賀。

translations.literal: At the waterside pavilion he saw a pair of mandarin ducks sporting on the pool; the emperor drew his bow and shot, piercing both with one arrow, and his attendants offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the waterside pavilion he saw two mandarin ducks playing on the pond. The emperor drew his bow and shot once, transfixing both; his attendants cried their congratulations.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前邠州節度使侯章為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Hou Zhang, former Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hou Zhang, former Military Commissioner of Bin, was appointed Military Commissioner of Deng.

sentences.zh: 前萊州刺史葉仁魯賜死，坐為民所訟故也。

translations.literal: Ye Renlu, former Prefect of Lai Prefecture, was granted death by suicide because the people had brought suit against him.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Renlu, former Prefect of Lai, was granted permission to take his own life after the people brought suit against him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔樞密使王峻巡視河堤。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the river dikes.

sentences.zh: 峻請行，故從之。

translations.literal: Jun had requested to go, and therefore the order was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had requested to go, and therefore the order was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the emperor visited South Manor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the emperor visited South Manor.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲申，朗州劉言、潭州王進逵奏，廣賊占據桂管，深入永州界俘劫，遣朗州行軍司馬何敬貞與指揮使朱全琇、陳順等，率水陸軍五萬進擊。

translations.literal: On the intercalary month, jiashen, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture and Wang Jinkui of Tan Prefecture memorialized that Guang bandits occupied Guiguan, raided deep into Yong Prefecture's border, and captured plunder; they dispatched He Jingzhen, Chief of Staff of Lang Prefecture, together with Commanders Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others to lead fifty thousand land and water troops in an advance attack.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month, jiashen, Liu Yan of Lang and Wang Jinkui of Tan memorialized that Guang bandits held Guiguan, raided deep into Yong Prefecture, and carried off captives and loot. They dispatched He Jingzhen, Chief of Staff of Lang, with Commanders Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others to lead fifty thousand land and water troops in an advance against them.

sentences.zh: 丙戊，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Uighurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Uighurs sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 詔故梁租庸使趙巖侄崇勛，見居陳州，量賜系官店宅，從王峻之請也。

translations.literal: An edict granted Chongxun, nephew of the late Tang-Revenue Commissioner Zhao Yan, who was then living in Chen Prefecture, state shops and mansions in appropriate measure — at Wang Jun's request.
translations.idiomatic: By edict, Chongxun, nephew of the late Revenue Commissioner Zhao Yan of Liang and then living in Chen Prefecture, was granted state shops and mansions in due measure — at Wang Jun's request.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定州奏，契丹攻義豐軍，出勁兵夜斫蕃營，斬首六十級，契丹遁去。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan attacked Yifeng Army; elite troops were sent out by night to strike the barbarian camp, beheading sixty, and the Khitan fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan had attacked Yifeng Army. Elite troops went out by night, struck the barbarian camp, took sixty heads, and the Khitan withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鎮州奏，契丹寇境，遣兵追襲，至無極而還。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhen Prefecture reported that the Khitan raided the border; troops were dispatched in pursuit to Wuji and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhen Prefecture reported a Khitan border raid. Troops were sent in pursuit as far as Wuji and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 丙申，皇子澶州節度使榮來朝。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Prince Rong, Military Commissioner of Chanzhou, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Prince Rong, Military Commissioner of Chanzhou, came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以樞密使、尚書左僕射、同平章事、監修國史王峻兼青州節度使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wang Jun, Privy Council Commissioner, Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for the Compilation of National History, was additionally made Military Commissioner of Qing Prefecture; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wang Jun — Privy Council Commissioner, Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for the Compilation of National History — was additionally appointed Military Commissioner of Qing; his other titles remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 延州衙內指揮使高紹基奏言：「父允權患腳膝，令臣權知軍州事。

translations.literal: Gao Shaoji, Inner Garrison Commander of Yan Prefecture, memorialized: "My father Yunquan suffers from knee and foot ailment and has ordered me to act as administrator of the prefecture and army.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shaoji, Inner Garrison Commander of Yan Prefecture, memorialized: "My father Yunquan is afflicted in the knees and feet and has directed me to serve as acting administrator of the prefecture and army.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，陳州奏：「吏民請與前刺史李穀立祠堂。

translations.literal: " On guimao, Chen Prefecture memorialized: "Officials and people request to establish a shrine to former Prefect Li Gu.
translations.idiomatic: " On guimao, Chen Prefecture memorialized: "Officials and commoners ask that a shrine be built to the former Prefect Li Gu.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 時穀為宰相，聞郡人陳請，遜讓數四，乃止。

translations.literal: At the time Gu was chief councilor; when he heard that the people of the commandery had petitioned, he declined repeatedly and the plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Gu was chief councilor at the time. When he learned that the people of the commandery had petitioned, he demurred again and again, and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守王殷加檢校太尉，依前同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Wang Yin, Administrator of Yedu, was advanced to Honorary Grand Guardian and continued as before as Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wang Yin, Administrator of Yedu, was advanced to Honorary Grand Guardian while retaining his Associate Grand Councilor title.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鎮州節度使何福進、河陽節度使王彥超並加檢校太尉，潞州節度使李筠加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, He Fujin, Military Commissioner of Zhen Prefecture, and Wang Yanchao, Military Commissioner of Heyang, were both advanced to Honorary Grand Guardian; Li Yun, Military Commissioner of Lu Prefecture, was advanced to Honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, He Fujin, Military Commissioner of Zhen, and Wang Yanchao, Military Commissioner of Heyang, were both promoted to Honorary Grand Guardian; Li Yun, Military Commissioner of Lu, was promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，延州節度使高允權卒。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Gao Yunquan, Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Gao Yunquan, Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，開封府奏，都城內錄到無名額僧尼寺院五十八所。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Kaifeng Prefecture reported that fifty-eight Buddhist and Daoist temples and monasteries without registered plaques had been recorded within the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Kaifeng Prefecture reported that fifty-eight temples and monasteries — Buddhist and Daoist alike — lacking registered name plaques had been logged within the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔廢之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished them.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥朔，以前西京留守白文珂為太子太師致仕，進封韓國公。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, xinhai, Bai Wenke, former Administrator of the Western Capital, was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and advanced to Duke of Han.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, Bai Wenke, former Administrator of the Western Capital, was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and advanced to Duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，安州節度使李洪義、侍衛馬軍都指揮使郭崇、侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英，並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On guichou, Li Hongyi, Military Commissioner of An Prefecture, Guo Chong, Commander of the Palace Horse Guard, and Cao Ying, Commander of the Palace Step Guard, were all advanced to Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Li Hongyi, Military Commissioner of An; Guo Chong, Commander of the Palace Horse Guard; and Cao Ying, Commander of the Palace Step Guard were all advanced to Honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 唐州方城縣令陳守愚棄市，坐克留戶民蠶鹽一千五百斤入己也。

translations.literal: Chen Shouyu, Magistrate of Fangcheng County in Tang Prefecture, was executed in the marketplace for having withheld for himself fifteen hundred jin of silkworm salt from the households.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shouyu, Magistrate of Fangcheng in Tang Prefecture, was executed in the marketplace for keeping fifteen hundred jin of silkworm salt levied from the households for himself.

sentences.zh: 內制國寶兩座，詔中書令馮道書寶文，其一以「皇帝承天受命之寶」為文，其一以「皇帝神寶」為文。

translations.literal: Two imperial seals were made by inner-court order; the emperor ordered Secretariat Director Feng Dao to inscribe the seal texts — one with the text "Seal of the Emperor Receiving the Mandate from Heaven," the other with "Seal of the Divine Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: By inner-court order two imperial seals were cast; the emperor commanded Secretariat Director Feng Dao to inscribe them — one reading "Seal of the Emperor Receiving the Mandate from Heaven," the other "Seal of the Divine Emperor."

sentences.zh: 案，傳國寶始自秦始皇，令李斯篆之，歷代傳授，事具前史。

translations.literal: Note: the transmission seal began with Qin Shihuang, who ordered Li Si to seal-script it; it was handed down through successive dynasties, as set forth in earlier histories.
translations.idiomatic: Note: the seal of dynastic transmission dates to Qin Shihuang, who had Li Si cut its inscription in seal script; it passed from dynasty to dynasty, as the earlier histories record.

sentences.zh: 至唐末帝自燔之際，以寶隨身，遂俱焚焉。

translations.literal: At the time when the Tang last emperor burned himself, he kept the seal on his person, and it was destroyed in the flames together with him.
translations.idiomatic: When the last Tang emperor set himself ablaze, he kept the seal on his person, and it was consumed with him in the fire.

sentences.zh: 晉高祖受命，特制寶一座，開運末，契丹犯闕，少帝遣其子延煦送於戎王，戎主，訝其非真，少帝上表具訴其事，及契丹北歸，賫以入蕃。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozu of Jin received the Mandate, a special seal was made. At the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan invaded the capital, the last emperor sent his son Yans Xu to deliver it to the Khitan king. The Khitan ruler was surprised that it was not genuine; the last emperor submitted a memorial explaining the matter in full. When the Khitan returned north, it was taken into their land as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozu of Jin received the Mandate, a new seal was specially made. At the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan stormed the capital, the last emperor sent his son Yans Xu to deliver it to the Khitan ruler. The Khitan king doubted its authenticity; the last emperor submitted a memorial setting out the full facts. When the Khitan withdrew north, the seal was carried off into their lands.

sentences.zh: 漢朝二帝，未暇別制，至是始創為之。

translations.literal: The two emperors of Han had no leisure to make another; only now was one first created.
translations.idiomatic: The two Han emperors had never found time to replace it; only now was a new seal first fashioned.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣將作監李瓊知陜州軍州事。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Qiong, Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, was sent to administer Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Qiong, Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, was dispatched to govern Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，樞密使、平盧軍節度使、尚書左僕射、平章事、監修國史王峻責授商州司馬，員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wang Jun, Privy Council Commissioner, Military Commissioner of Pinglu Army, Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for the Compilation of National History, was demoted to Regional Administrator of Shang Prefecture, appointed outside the regular roster, and ordered expelled by express relay from his place of assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wang Jun — Privy Council Commissioner, Military Commissioner of Pinglu Army, Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for the Compilation of National History — was demoted to Regional Administrator of Shang Prefecture on an extra-statutory appointment and ordered expelled by urgent relay from wherever he was posted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，左監門上將軍李建崇卒。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Li Jianchong, Left Gate General of the Upper Rank, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Jianchong, Left Gate General of the Upper Rank, died.

sentences.zh: 延州牙內都指揮使高紹基奏，交割軍府與副使張圖。

translations.literal: Gao Shaoji, Inner Garrison Commander of Yan Prefecture, memorialized that he had turned over the military headquarters to Vice Commissioner Zhang Tu.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shaoji, Inner Garrison Commander of Yan Prefecture, memorialized that he had handed over military headquarters to Vice Commissioner Zhang Tu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朗州劉言奏，當道先遣行軍司馬何敬貞率兵掩擊廣賊，行及潭州，部眾奔潰，湖南王進逵以敬貞失律，已梟首訖。

translations.literal: On jisi, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture memorialized that his circuit had earlier dispatched Chief of Staff He Jingzhen to lead troops in a surprise attack on Guang bandits; when they reached Tan Prefecture the troops broke and fled; Wang Jinkui of Hunan, because Jingzhen had violated military discipline, had already beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liu Yan of Lang memorialized that his circuit had earlier sent Chief of Staff He Jingzhen to lead a surprise strike against Guang bandits. When the column reached Tan Prefecture the troops broke and fled. Wang Jinkui of Hunan, finding that Jingzhen had violated military discipline, had already executed him.

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、工部侍郎陳觀為秘書監。

translations.literal: Chen Guan, Privy Council Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan, Privy Council Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鳳翔少尹桑能責授鄧州長史。

translations.literal: On renshen, Sang Neng, Assistant Administrator of Feng Prefecture, was demoted to Senior Administrator of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Sang Neng, Assistant Administrator of Feng, was demoted to Senior Administrator of Deng.

sentences.zh: 能，晉相維翰之庶弟也，坐據維翰別第為人所訟故也。

translations.literal: Neng was the younger half-brother of Jin chancellor Sang Weihan; he was demoted because he had occupied Weihan's separate residence and was sued by others.
translations.idiomatic: Neng was the younger half-brother of the Jin chancellor Sang Weihan. He was punished because he had seized Weihan's private residence and others brought suit against him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以戶部侍郎、知貢舉趙上交為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and Examination Commissioner, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and Examination Commissioner, was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 是歲，新進士中有李觀者，不當策名，物議喧然，中書門下以觀所試詩賦失韻，勾落姓名，故上交移官。

translations.literal: That year among the newly passed jinshi was one Li Guan who should not have been listed; public criticism was loud. The Secretariat and Chancellery found that Guan's submitted poetry and fu violated rhyme rules and struck his name; therefore Shangjiao was transferred.
translations.idiomatic: That year among the newly passed jinshi was a candidate named Li Guan who should never have been listed. Public outcry was fierce. The Secretariat and Chancellery found that Guan's examination poetry and fu broke the rhyme rules and struck his name from the rolls; Shangjiao was reassigned as a result.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸南莊，賜從官射。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the emperor visited South Manor and granted archery to his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the emperor visited South Manor and granted archery to his attendants.

sentences.zh: 命客省使向訓權知延州軍州事。

translations.literal: The Envoy of the Reception Bureau Xiang Xun was appointed acting administrator of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Envoy of the Reception Bureau Xiang Xun was appointed acting administrator of Yan Prefecture.
